posts.title: 11997 - Dreaming
posts.description: T-minus 11,997 days I had a strange dream the other night. I don't know how or why, but I was trapped in Europe, France, I think, trying to find my way home to my family here in England. There had been some kind of attack, or even a natural disaster of some kind. I'm a bit blurry on the details. Anyhoo, I was stuck. No phone, no money and no help available. I remember walking down a country lane.

posts.title: 12000 - Orbit 58 🌍 ☀️
posts.description: T-minus 12,000 days The Pale Blue Dot is a photograph of Earth taken on 14 February 1990 by NASA’s Voyager 1 at a distance of 3.7 billion miles (6 billion kilometres) from the Sun. Today is my 58th birthday. I’ve orbited the Sun 58 times. That’s about 34 billion miles! It still amazes me that we’re on a rock hurtling round the Sun at about 67,000 mph.
